A vertical edge with one in-between pixel at x = 7, and sigma 1, low threshold 40 and high threshold 100. Every row is the same, so the gradient points along x and each pixel is compared with its left and right neighbors. The magnitude peaks at x = 7, and only that pixel survives thinning. Its value, 448.6, is above 100, so it is a strong pixel and becomes an edge. The edge is one pixel wide.
